_comment: This file has the fraud rules and thresholds used by upi_fraudscope.py. Sources are listed for each one (RBI/NPCI/I4C advisories) so they're not just made up. There's no real live database of scam UPI IDs since banks/I4C don't publish that data, so the sample list at the bottom is just a few made-up examples to show how the rule would work.

fraud_growth.detail: Reported cyber-financial fraud cases rose from 2.6 lakh in 2021 to 28 lakh in 2025; reported fraud value rose from Rs 551 crore in 2021 to nearly Rs 22,931 crore in 2025, per RBI's own discussion paper.
fraud_growth.source: RBI discussion paper on UPI fraud prevention, cited in market reporting, April 2026

two_factor_mandate.detail: RBI direction RBI/2025-26/219 mandates two-factor authentication (a dynamic factor like OTP/biometrics plus a knowledge/possession factor) for all digital payment transactions, effective 1 April 2026.

mule_hunter_ai.detail: RBI has deployed 'MuleHunter.AI', an AI-driven system to identify mule accounts (accounts used to quickly move/launder fraud proceeds), live in 26 banks as of early-mid 2026.
mule_hunter_ai.source: RBI public statements, cited in financial press, April 2026

fraud_risk_indicator.detail: DoT's Financial Fraud Risk Indicator (FRI) classifies mobile numbers into risk tiers (medium/high/very high) based on data from I4C's National Cybercrime Reporting Portal (NCRP), DoT's Chakshu platform, and bank-shared intelligence. RBI advised all scheduled commercial banks to integrate FRI from 30 June 2025.
fraud_risk_indicator.source: RBI advisory dated 30 June 2025; DoT/RBI joint statement

qr_and_collect_request_fraud_share.detail: QR code swaps and fake UPI collect requests are estimated to account for roughly 40% of FY26 UPI fraud value (~Rs 805 crore), concentrated at small merchants (street food, fuel stations, small retail).
qr_and_collect_request_fraud_share.source: Industry fraud-trend reporting citing NCRB/I4C patterns, March 2026

scam_categories.name: Prize / Lottery / KBC scam
scam_categories.description: Victim is told they've won a prize/lottery and must pay a 'release fee' or 'tax' via UPI to claim it. Real lotteries/shows never require payment to release winnings.
scam_categories.source: Widely reported scam pattern; referenced in I4C/CyberDost public advisories

scam_categories.name: Customs / parcel / FedEx scam
scam_categories.description: Victim is told a parcel is held at customs and a fee must be paid via UPI to release it. No legitimate customs process is settled via personal UPI payment.
scam_categories.source: Widely reported scam pattern; referenced in I4C/CyberDost public advisories

scam_categories.name: Digital arrest / fake law enforcement scam
scam_categories.description: Victim is threatened with arrest or legal action (often via video call impersonating police/CBI/customs) and pressured to transfer funds 'for verification'. A genuine, large-scale scam category specifically named in Indian government cyber-fraud advisories.
scam_categories.source: I4C/MHA public advisories on 'digital arrest' scams

scam_categories.name: Screen-sharing / remote-access scam
scam_categories.description: A caller posing as bank/UPI customer support persuades the victim to install a remote-access app (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Quick Support) to 'fix' an issue, then captures OTPs and authorizes transactions directly.
scam_categories.source: NPCI advisory, March 2026: never install remote access apps at a bank's request

scam_categories.name: Fake customer-care number scam
scam_categories.description: Victim searches for a bank/UPI helpline online, finds an SEO-optimized fake support page, calls a fraudulent number, and is guided into a 'Rs 1 verification payment' that actually authorizes a large debit via a malicious collect request.
scam_categories.source: I4C advisory Q2 2026 — reported ~4,200 fake customer-care pages removed from search results

scam_categories.name: QR code swap / fake collect request
scam_categories.description: Fraudster physically swaps a merchant's displayed QR code, or sends a 'collect' request disguised as a 'pay' request, so scanning/approving it actually debits the victim instead of crediting them.
scam_categories.source: RBI circular DPSS.CO.PD 2025-26 advising merchants to physically verify QR codes daily

known_fraud_upi_ids_sample._note: Illustrative examples only, built from the kinds of keyword patterns documented above (prize/lottery/customs/helpdesk wording commonly seen in scam UPI handles). NOT a real, live crowd-sourced database - no such public database of scam UPI handles exists, for the same reason malware IOC feeds can be public but financial fraud identifiers generally aren't (privacy, rapid rotation, takedown-before-disclosure). Treat this list as a stand-in to demonstrate the rule engine, not as a usable blocklist.
